Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring persons convicted of driving under the influence to be issued fluorescent yellow license plates to operate motor vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fluorescent yellow license plates for personsconvicted of driving under the influence; reenacting and amending RCW46.63.020; adding a new section to chapter 46.16 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 46.61 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall create and issue a vehicle license numberplate, for display at the front and rear of a motor vehicle, availableonly to those convicted of a crime pursuant to RCW 46.61.502. Bothfront and rear license plates shall be fluorescent yellow but otherwiseconform to the standards described within this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person convicted of a crime pursuant to RCW 46.61.502 who hasno prior offense may not operate a motor vehicle, which does not havefluorescent yellow license plates issued under section 1 of this act,for a term of one year from the date of conviction or final resolution p. 1 SB 6817on appeal. A person convicted of a crime pursuant to RCW 46.61.502 whohas a prior conviction under RCW 46.61.502 shall not operate a motorvehicle unless it has fluorescent yellow license plates issued undersection 1 of this act. A violation of this act is a gross misdemeanor.
